newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 25.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
Chinese President Jiang Zemin describes as "friendly, positive and constructive" his meeting with U.S. President Bill Clinton.
China's macro-economic control with curbing inflation as primary task has met its pre-set target, according to four-day central economic work conference.
China's State Council closes four financial institutions that were set up illegally and lent money at usurious rates.
China says draft law on stationing troops in Hong Kong after the British colony reverts to Chinese rule in 1997 means its soldiers would be under tight control.
